from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,tarfile,os,json,hashlib,time
root=Path('/private/tmp/logex-current-phase-profile'); assert not root.exists();root.mkdir()
archive=Path('/private/tmp/logex-independent-index.tar');assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='4475e14327dc3af022f1fcef115cf86b95d2f8ce3147da0eddfbc3018b1efb3a'
with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:tar.extractall(root,filter='data')
# Diagnostic timings only: never part of production or acceptance timings.
storage=root/'crates/logex-storage/src/native/storage.rs'
s=storage.read_text();key='    pub fn open(config: NativeStorageConfig) -> std::io::Result<Self> {\n';assert s.count(key)==1
s=s.replace(key,key+'        let mut audit_last = std::time::Instant::now();\n        let mut audit_phase = |label: &str| { let now = std::time::Instant::now(); eprintln!("AUDIT_OPEN {label} {}", now.duration_since(audit_last).as_secs_f64()*1000.0); audit_last = std::time::Instant::now(); };\n')
for key,label in [('        verify_recent_headers(&catalog.state)?;','catalog_and_headers'),('        let wal = WriteAheadLog::open(config.data_dir.join("wal").join("pending.wal"))?;','wal_open'),('        storage.verify_recovery_evidence()?;','recovery_evidence'),('        durability::sync_directory(storage.paths.root())?;','harden_root'),('        storage.restore_catalog_checkpoint()?;','restore_catalog'),('        storage.ensure_active_hot_segment()?;','active_hot'),('        storage.replay_wal()?;','replay_wal'),('        storage.repair_recoverable_hot_segment_artifacts()?;','repair_hot'),('        storage.repair_recoverable_historical_segment_artifacts()?;','repair_history'),('        storage.verify_integrity()?;','verify_integrity')]:
 assert s.count(key)==1,(key,s.count(key));s=s.replace(key,key+'\n        audit_phase("'+label+'");')

for method,begin,write in [
 ('live','        self.begin_checkpoint_batch(rows, IngestRoute::Live)?;','        self.commit_rows_to_segments(rows)?;'),
 ('history','        self.begin_checkpoint_batch(rows, IngestRoute::Historical)?;','        let appended = self.write_historical_rows(rows)?;')]:
 a=s.index(begin);b=s.index('\n    }',a);part=s[a:b]
 part='        let audit_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n'+part
 part=part.replace(begin,begin+'\n        eprintln!("AUDIT_WRITE '+method+'_wal {}", audit_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64()*1000.0);\n        let audit_start = std::time::Instant::now();')
 part=part.replace(write,write+'\n        eprintln!("AUDIT_WRITE '+method+'_columns {}", audit_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64()*1000.0);')
 s=s[:a]+part+s[b:]
storage.write_text(s)

index=root/'crates/logex-index/src/builder.rs';s=index.read_text();key='    pub fn build_indexes(partition_dir: &Path, profile: IndexBuildProfile) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n';assert s.count(key)==1
s=s.replace(key,key+'        let mut audit_last = std::time::Instant::now();\n        let mut audit_phase = |label: &str| { let now = std::time::Instant::now(); eprintln!("AUDIT_INDEX {label} {}", now.duration_since(audit_last).as_secs_f64()*1000.0); audit_last = std::time::Instant::now(); };\n')
a=s.index(key);b=s.index('    ///',a+len(key));part=s[a:b]
for key,label in [('        let checkpoint = Self::begin_publication(partition_dir)?;','begin'),('                Self::build_primary_indexes_unpublished(partition_dir)?;','primary'),('                CompositeIndexBuilder::build_composite_indexes(partition_dir)?;','composite'),('                Erc20EventBloom::build(partition_dir, &index_dir)?;','event'),('        checkpoint.publish()?;','publish')]:
 part=part.replace(key,key+'\n        audit_phase("'+label+'");')
s=s[:a]+part+s[b:];index.write_text(s)
for path in root.rglob('*'):
 if path.is_file() and (path.suffix=='.rs' or path.name in ['Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml']):os.utime(path,None)
os.chdir(root);os.environ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']='/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex/target'
records=[]
for label,package,target in [('query','logex-query','audit_harness'),('publication','logex-storage','ingestion_publication')]:
 cmd=['cargo','test','-p',package,'--release','--test',target,'--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'];start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE);(root/(label+'-build.log')).write_text(r.stderr)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
 bins=[json.loads(l)['executable']for l in r.stdout.splitlines()if json.loads(l).get('executable')];assert len(bins)==1
 import shutil;dest=root/(label+'-tests');shutil.copy2(bins[0],dest)
 records.append({'label':label,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()});print(records[-1],flush=True)
(root/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
